Title: Provision Azure staging and production
Description: Create repeatable environments for App Service, Azure SQL, and Key Vault with managed identity.
Acceptance criteria: Provision both environments from the same configuration; enforce HTTPS; staging cannot access production data or secrets; runtime identity can perform required SQL operations and cannot change schema.

Title: Configure Entra External ID
Inputs needed: Access to the Entra external tenant
Description: Configure sign-up, sign-in, sign-out, and callback URLs for both environments.
Acceptance criteria: Staging learners can register, sign in, sign out, and sign in again; expired sessions return to sign-in; a second learner cannot see the first learner's chat history. Live Entra testing verifies callback URLs, session cookie behavior, logout, and expired-session handling over HTTPS.

Title: Automate build, migration, and deployment
Description: Build one immutable package, deploy to staging, and promote the same package to production using workload identity.
Acceptance criteria: CI runs the React build and .NET tests; a separate migration identity applies EF migrations to staging; promotion requires staging checks and an explicit approval; prior artifact and schema-compatible rollback steps are documented.

Title: Approve and import launch lessons
Inputs needed: Production curriculum and launch languages from the content owner
Description: Convert and validate authored lessons, then import them into staging using their permanent IDs.
Acceptance criteria: Content owner approves all launch lessons; lesson order, language, examples, and opening text render correctly; reimporting a correction preserves existing histories; only approved lessons appear in production.

Title: Finalize and evaluate Learning and Practice rules
Inputs needed: Final tutor instructions and sample exchanges from the product owner
Description: Replace provisional rules, agree a pass rubric, and test representative conversations for both modes.
Acceptance criteria: Approved cases cover explanations, corrections, practice hints and answer timing, off-topic requests, and attempts to override tutor rules; both modes pass the agreed rubric; model and prompt versions are recorded.

Title: Apply tutor usage limits and outage handling
Description: Set learner and environment limits for OpenAI requests and preserve safe retries when dependencies fail.
Acceptance criteria: Learner limits return 429 with clear retry guidance even across app instances; a provider timeout, rate limit, or malformed response leaves no partial exchange; retried submissions do not save duplicate exchanges; staging verifies the configured limits.

Title: Implement learner data retention and deletion
Inputs needed: Product approval of retention and privacy policy
Description: Document what is stored in Azure SQL and sent to OpenAI, then support the approved retention and deletion process.
Acceptance criteria: A learner can request deletion through the documented process; a staging deletion removes the correct learner's chats and messages; logs contain no prompts, replies, tokens, or secrets; the privacy notice explains retention, backups, and provider processing. The deletion drill also covers profiles, settings, and progress.

Title: Add health checks, alerting, and cost visibility
Description: Expose health and readiness checks and set up telemetry and alerts for app, database, and tutor failures.
Acceptance criteria: Readiness detects SQL unavailability without consuming OpenAI tokens; dashboards show latency, errors, provider throttling, and usage; alert tests reach the named owner; logs carry request IDs without chat content.

Title: Run browser and accessibility acceptance tests
Depends on: MURLY-02, MURLY-03, MURLY-04, MURLY-05, MURLY-13, MURLY-14, MURLY-15
Description: Verify the published staging app in supported desktop and mobile browsers with real sign-in and tutor replies.
Acceptance criteria: A learner opens a stored lesson, sends in both modes, switches lessons, and resumes the correct histories after refresh; keyboard and screen-reader flows cover the mobile drawer and composer; stale sends and provider errors surface clearly and preserve the draft. Verify profile editing, settings persistence, and progress across two sessions.

Title: Verify Azure SQL integrity and capacity
Inputs needed: Expected launch traffic and agreed latency targets
Description: Exercise the real Azure SQL provider and collect a representative load baseline using synthetic learners.
Acceptance criteria: Azure SQL integration checks cover migration, import, isolation, concurrent sends, and retries; long chat histories are tested; launch load meets agreed latency and error targets or blocks promotion.

Title: Build a learner profile
Inputs needed: Product approval of editable profile fields
Description: Add a profile screen and authenticated read/update endpoints backed by a learner record. Use the Entra issuer and subject to link the record. Define which fields Entra owns.
Acceptance criteria: A newly signed-in learner can view the profile and update approved fields; edits survive sign-out and appear on a second device; a second learner cannot access or edit the profile.

Title: Build persistent learner settings
Inputs needed: Product approval of launch preferences and defaults
Description: Add a settings screen and authenticated read/update endpoints. Apply each supported preference wherever it affects the learner experience.
Acceptance criteria: A new learner sees documented defaults; saves and resets persist across sessions and devices; unsupported values are rejected and changes remain private to the learner.

Title: Track lesson progress and expose a summary
Inputs needed: Product approval of what counts as starting and completing a lesson
Description: Define per-lesson and per-mode progress states. Store completion separately from chat revision and surface progress in the sidebar and learner summary. Define how existing chat histories initialize progress.
Acceptance criteria: Approved events update progress once; retries and multiple tabs do not double-count completion; progress persists across devices and remains isolated per learner; an existing chat is handled according to the migration rule.

Title: Document and test the REST API contract
Description: Publish an OpenAPI contract for the shipped resource endpoints and document browser sign-in and sign-out separately. Record response schemas, authorization, errors, and retry semantics.
Acceptance criteria: Contract checks cover lessons, chats, messages, session, profile, settings, and progress as shipped; documented responses match the API, including unauthorized, not found, conflict, and validation cases; CI catches incompatible changes.

Title: Rehearse backup restore and rollback
Inputs needed: Agreed recovery time and recovery point targets
Description: Rehearse database recovery and previous-release deployment in a safe environment.
Acceptance criteria: Restore a backup to an isolated database; confirm chats and lessons recover within agreed targets; roll back the app without losing new chats; document how to handle migrations and identify the incident owner.

Title: Launch pilot and promote to production
Depends on: MURLY-04, MURLY-05, MURLY-06, MURLY-07, MURLY-08, MURLY-09, MURLY-10, MURLY-11, MURLY-16
Description: Verify the signed-in learner journey with approved content before opening broader access.
Acceptance criteria: Staging and production smoke checks cover sign-in, approved lesson loading, and a live tutor reply in each mode; launch blockers are closed; operations confirms alerts and rollback access; pilot metrics and feedback meet agreed exit criteria before broader release.
